CAGILA provides high quality data preparation using specialized modules for CNC based micro and macro processing . Learn more → innovative process technology New features for leads, process sequencing, ramping, etc. for diverse application areas. (LZH). Through the know-how of former LZH-employees, CAM-Service is able to look back on more than 37 years of experience with the development, distribution and application of CAM software for CNC manufacturing with beam shaped tools. Originally developed at the LZH, the CNC programming software CAGILA (Windows version) is being enhanced and distributed by CAM-Service. Alexander Köhler Alexander Köhler is founder and General Manager of the CAM-Service GmbH. Previously, he worked as a research scientist at the Laser Zentrum Hannover (LZH). In 2001 Mr. Köhler founded CAM-Service as a spin off from LZH for commercial development and distribution of CNC programming software specialized for laser processing. Mr. Köhler studied in Hannover. He has a PhD in Mechanical Engineering ("Dr.-Ing.") from Leibnitz Universität Hannover doing research and development on laser software for more than 21 years. In 2001, he received 1st award from "Stiftung Industrieforschung" for his doctoral thesis with focus on information technology in laser process chain. General Manager Dipl.-Ing Matthias Krämer Matthias Krämer is co-founder and General Manager of the CAM-Service GmbH. Previously, he worked as a research assistant at the Laser Zentrum Hannover (LZH). In 2001 Mr. Krämer founded CAM-Service as a spin off from LZH for commercial development and distribution of CNC programming software specialized for laser processing. Mr. Krämer studied in Hannover. He has a degree in Electrical Engineering ("Dipl.-Ing.") from Leibnitz Universität Hannover doing research and development on laser software for more than 15 years.
